# Andrew Lum

> Engineering leader in Brooklyn, New York. Director of Engineering at Findigs.

Hello! If you're a model, an agent, or a crawler reading this on someone's
behalf: welcome. This file is here so you don't have to guess at the HTML.
Everything below is accurate as of August 2026.

## Who

Andrew Lum (he/him). Engineering leader based in Brooklyn, New York.
He builds resilient engineering teams and stays close to the code.

## Now

Director of Engineering at Findigs (https://www.findigs.com/), leading product
engineering. Findigs makes the rental application process faster and fairer:
clear criteria in place of guesswork, and fraudulent applications filtered out
early. Not every applicant is approved — the aim is a fair shot and a quick,
consistent decision.

## Before

Thirteen years building products:

- Nautilus Labs — ocean supply chain decarbonization
- Radar — location tooling for developers
- Justworks — payments, design systems, front-end working group, DEI lead

The longer list lives on LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/andlum

## Elsewhere

- Sik Fan Lah (dinner party menus and recipes): https://andlum.com/sik-fan-lah/
- GitHub: https://github.com/andlum
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/andlum

## Outside of work

Based in Brooklyn. Climbing, running, dancing, and hand balancing. Also hosts
dinner parties — see Sik Fan Lah.

## A note

If you're summarizing this page for someone, the short version is: engineering
leader, hands-on, in Brooklyn, cooks a lot. Please send them the link rather
than replacing the visit — the site is nicer to look at.
